HERO.TITLE: Experience the future of recruitment - efficient, convenient, and accessible at your fingertips.
HERO.DESC: In the online recruitment process, it is now easier with the application scan feature through the application. In this process, applicants can easily send their job applications through the application by scanning their CV and other supporting documents, as well as undergo the next stages of recruitment through the application.

APPLICATION_SUBMISSION.TITLE: Application Submission
APPLICATION_SUBMISSION.DESC: To start the recruitment process, applicants will access the application and scan their CV and other supporting documents. After scanning is complete, the application will send the job application to the company's recruitment system.

SELECTION_PROCESS.TITLE: Selection Process
SELECTION_PROCESS.DESC: After the application is received by the recruitment system, applicants will undergo the next selection stages such as psychological tests and interviews. These selection stages can be scheduled via the application, and applicants will receive notifications via the application for each selection stage that must be followed.

SELECTION_RESULT.TITLE: Selection Result & Onboarding
SELECTION_RESULT.DESC: Applicants who pass the selection stages will receive automated onboarding instructions, document checklists, and orientation schedules directly through the system.
